# External investment and market data (2026-09-27)

Collected for the "External comparison" lines of the brief (chapters 1, 3, 4), on the author's request.
Figures are copied from the publisher pages or trade-press summaries listed in each row (accessed
2026-09-27). Market forecasts are commercial projections of revenue with undisclosed methods; the
brief uses them for scale only, never as validation. Funding figures from different trackers are
not strictly comparable (VFS counts eVTOL companies; McKinsey counts "future air mobility", which
includes other segments).
